speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to begin our assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (listeriosis).
Your history of eating ice cream three days before developing these flu-like symptoms at 30 weeks gestation is highly characteristic of this condition, which can cause severe complications for the fetus. We need to confirm this immediately with a blood culture. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture.
